title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots
tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

faults.what: The sampled frames show a basic slideshow-style presentation with blurred screenshot side fills and little visible motion, making the visual treatment less energetic than requested.

judge.summary: A clean, basic widescreen ad shows both readable screenshots in the correct order and ends with a clear FitTrack title, though the visuals lack energy.

must_haves.item: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 10 seconds, and the output frames are landscape 16:9.

must_haves.item: The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
must_haves.why: The home screen appears at 1.3 and 3.8 seconds, followed by the workout screen at 6.3 seconds.

must_haves.item: Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
must_haves.why: Both screenshots retain their supplied layouts, labels, and values, with readable text and no visible replacement UI.
The 8.8-second frame displays a large, clear FitTrack title on white.

must_haves.item: An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The sound report confirms audio and no clear speech, but does not establish whether the audio is an upbeat instrumental track.
